Retrieving armor with a command
This command is available only while you are in Creative mode:
/fac greenwich_plate <style> <piece> <metal> [cover] [trim] [decoration] [color]

Replace <style> with armet for a helmet or noble for body and leg armor. Replace <piece> with head, body, legs, or all; “all” retrieves every piece available in the chosen style. Replace <metal> with iron, meteoriciron, or steel.

The remaining keywords are optional but must stay in this order. Replace [cover] with a coating metal allowed for the chosen base metal, [trim] with an allowed rim metal, [decoration] with a decoration listed above for that armor piece, and [color] with one of the listed decoration colors. Use none for an omitted cover, trim, decoration, or decoration color when you need to reach a later keyword.
